## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 标准分区过滤 (必选)
grass_date = '{date}'              -- 日期分区
h = {hour}                         -- 小时分区 (0-23)

-- 扣费操作类型过滤
translog.operation = 11            -- 扣费事件 (operation=11)

-- 扣费状态过滤
status IN ('STATUS_OK', 'STATUS_PARTIAL_OK')   -- 成功扣费
status IS NULL                                   -- 失败扣费 (error)
status NOT IN ('STATUS_OK', 'STATUS_PARTIAL_OK') -- 异常扣费

-- 扣费明细非空
cost_details IS NOT NULL
cardinality(cost_details) > 0

-- 指定扣费记录
translog.deduct_unique_id = {deduct_unique_id}
translog.adsid = {ads_id}

-- OCPM 过滤 (在 UNNEST 后)
cost_details[].is_ocpm = true

-- 出价类型过滤 (通过 translog struct)
CAST(json_extract(to_json(translog), '$.placement') AS INT) IN (40, 50)
```

    WHERE grass_date = '2026-06-01'

### 5. OCPM 曝光 pCTR 分析 (PySpark)

```sql
WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        f.grass_date, f.h, f.country AS grass_region,
        COALESCE(
            CAST(get_json_object(get_json_object(to_json(cd), '$.json_data'), '$.item_id') AS BIGINT),
            CAST(get_json_object(to_json(f.translog), '$.itemid') AS BIGINT)
        ) AS item_id,
        CAST(get_json_object(get_json_object(to_json(cd), '$.json_data'), '$.pCTR') AS DOUBLE) AS pctr
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_finance_deduction_event_hi__ph_s0_live f
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(f.cost_details) t AS cd
    WHERE f.grass_date = date('2026-05-06')
      AND f.h = 9
      AND f.cost_details IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(get_json_object(to_json(f.translog), '$.operation') AS INT) = 11
      AND CAST(get_json_object(to_json(f.translog), '$.placement') AS INT) IN (40, 50)
      AND COALESCE(LOWER(get_json_object(to_json(cd), '$.is_ocpm')), 'false') = 'true'
      AND get_json_object(to_json(cd), '$.json_data') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT grass_date, grass_region, h, item_id,
    COUNT(1) AS ocpm_exposure_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pctr > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ocpm_exposure_with_valid_pctr_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pctr > 0 THEN pctr ELSE 0.0 END) AS ocpm_sum_pctr,
    AVG(CASE WHEN pctr > 0 THEN pctr ELSE NULL END) AS ocpm_avg_pctr
FROM normalized
WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region, h, item_id;
```
